title: 孩子基本資料 / Baby Buddy Child Detail
presentation: Original full template hierarchy rendered locally with deterministic upstream-test-derived synthetic data; no redesign or health record
source_actions: Reports dropdown with five report links
environment_differences: Django template engine 5.2.8 under Python 3.12.14, rather than pinned app Django 1.11.6; no historical server/models/database run.

Same-commit CSS from C-03 reused unchanged; built with libsass 0.23.0 instead of original gulp/node-sass. Original theme/Bootstrap/Font Awesome mappings are retained; report timeline and vendor date-picker CSS are not included.
Same-commit source templates remain byte-exact in upstream. In-memory transformations replace static paths and remove unused favicons/PWA assets.
Fixed UTC midnight evaluates the test's timezone.localdate() to 2017-10-28; same-day date yields the source timesince text 0 minutes, not an invented day/month-age label.
Synthetic caregiver non-staff user, ordinary source permissions enabled, no active timers. All rendered permission choices are declared in fixture.json.

Every route href is removed, route identity retained in data-preview-route, aria-disabled/tabindex/title added; links cannot navigate even without JS. Dropdown href hashes also removed; keyboard activation adapter preserves the local dropdown trigger.
Original app/API/refresh JS omitted. Only local source-version Bootstrap dropdown/collapse vendor behavior and non-persistence safety adapter are loaded.
CSP denies connections, forms and frames. Source-native incorrect Timer actions label and icon-only controls are deliberately retained, not redesigned.
limits: No browser, desktop/mobile visual inspection, dropdown/collapse execution, keyboard/screen-reader acceptance or cross-browser checks performed.
No original screenshot of this Child Detail page was asserted or copied; the historical screenshot used for C-03 is a different Dashboard page.
Historical vendor assets are for this isolated reference only, not production dependencies.
No backend, real family data, photo, external service, model call, saved state, upload, publication, PR or merge.
